data: PA is still on the BUY side in the macro view but is stuck in a retracement on MN/W1. Wait to enter H4 orders in the 180.00 - 185.00 zone to take profit and aim for a break of 200.00 - 210.00. In this zone, the price will SW (sideways), allowing Sell orders stuck around 190.00 - 195.00 to close out once. However, if it breaks 200, it will immediately open a new Upside cycle.

PA is clearly on the SELL side due to a Panic Sell in the MN/W1 view. You should wait for a bounce to enter H4 orders in the 45.00 - 48.00 zone to hold down for profit at the 25.00 - 30.00 zone. This rebound will be the last chance for Buy orders stuck at the top in the 50.00 - 60.00 zone to cut losses and preserve capital before the price drops deep to make a New Low.

PA is fully on the SELL side after breaking the Low to form a Lower High on W1. The advantageous H4 entry is to wait for a bounce to test the 38.00 - 40.00 resistance to hold down for profit at the previous base of 28.00 - 30.00. This area will be where the price SWs, giving short-term Buy orders that accidentally 'caught the knife' around 36.00 - 38.00 a chance to escape once before the 40.00 resistance pushes the price down for a long run.

PA is clearly on the BUY side due to momentum from MN/W1. Wait to enter H4/H1 orders in the 1,000 - 1,020 zone to take profit at the 1,100 psychological resistance. At that point, the price will SW, giving Sell orders stuck around 1,000 - 1,040 a chance to escape once before the price raises the 1,000 base into a permanent support to continue upward.

PA is fully on the BUY side following a W1 breakout. The most advantageous H4 entry is to wait for the price to retrace and test the 442 - 450 support to run the trend toward 500 - 520. This will be the point where counter-trend Sell orders near 460 - 470 can fix their portfolios once during the resistance hit, before 500 becomes a new base in the future.

PA is a Healthy Trend BUY with clear higher lows. You should wait to enter H4/H1 around the 600 - 610 zone to take profit near 680. This zone will feature an SW allowing short-term Sell orders around 630 - 640 to close their cycle. As long as the price does not drop below 600, the Buy side remains in control to establish a new base higher up.

PA is characterized by Re-accumulation for the BUY side after the price successfully held above the key psychological support at 3999.81 strongly. The advantageous H4 entry is waiting to receive in the 4030.00 - 4050.00 area or as close to the 3999.81 support line as possible, to run the trend up to the first resistance target at 4130.34. At this point, the price will SW sideways, giving Sell orders stuck from the previous drop around 4100 - 4150 a chance to adjust their portfolio or break even once before the price chooses a direction toward the main resistance at 4175.71, which is a tough barrier for this bullish round.

PA is in a decision phase between two poles, with the 3,886 support being the final deadline for the BUY side (if broken, it drops long) and the 4,175 resistance being the first barrier for the SELL side. The strategy is to play at the edges; the 4,032 zone is the safest Buy entry to aim for a bounce toward 4,175, allowing those stuck at the top to offload some positions.

PA is still trapped in an accumulation range, with the decisive point for the SELL side at the 4,219 - 4,253 resistance. If the price tests this and fails, it will be a trigger to smash it down to 4,032 again. However, if it successfully breaks 4,219, Sell orders blocking the 4,175 - 4,200 zone will be dragged until they must surrender immediately, shifting momentum to a full uptrend.

PA is short-term BUY to challenge the structure. Wait to enter H4 at the 4,032 - 4,083 zone (Buy bait zone) to chase the price up to TP levels at 4,175 and 4,219. This zone will be a decision point for Sell orders that tried to smash or are stuck around 4,130 - 4,150 to quickly escape once before the price decides whether to break the major resistance or fall back down.

The macro PA remains pressured, but it is an opportunity for the BUY side waiting to collect cheap assets. If the price drops below 4,000, wait for a Sniper entry at the 3,842 - 3,886 zone (Zone 1 & 2) to eat a big portion from the bounce. This will be the point where retail traders Panic Sell, allowing big players to accumulate and pull the price back to check 4,000 again, giving hope to those stuck above.

PA focuses on waiting for a Buy Bait at the 3,998 - 4,010 zone to trap the Buy side's Stop Losses before a strong rebound to 4,130. This point will be the last chance for Buy orders stuck around 4,050 to break even.

PA is creating a Lower Resistance trap to lure Sells. The strategy is to wait for a Buy entry at the 4,032 - 4,040 bait zone to counter-trend trade short-term and hunt the Stop Losses of those who rushed to Sell with the flow.

PA confirms a clear BUY side after successfully clearing the bait zone. Wait to add positions when the price retraces to test 4,097 or breaks 4,134 to run the trend toward 4,203, which is a tough barrier where a large chunk of Sell orders are waiting to smash.

PA is in a Re-accumulation phase for the BUY side, with the price hitting a key Check Point resistance at 4,150. It must wait for a candle to close above this level to confirm further upside. If it fails, the price likely dips to 4,132 to let those who missed the train enter and let stuck Sell orders cut their losses first.

PA is forming a Breakout pattern, with the current candle being the Decision Candle. If it closes above 4,159 successfully, it will destroy all Sell PA structures and immediately drag the price up to 4,242, leaving Sell orders blocking the way with no chance to recover.

PA is highly volatile. The first order at 4,136 is considered an Aggressive Buy (high risk) to catch momentum. However, if the price retraces deeply to 4,097, it will be a safer point. This zone will determine if the buying force is still in control or if it is just dragging price up to slaughter.

PA is entering the Volume Clearing zone at 4,191, where big players are starting to Take Profit in the 4,158 - 4,175 zone. This creates a chance for a sharp price correction to flush out retail Buy positions that chased the price late before choosing a direction to continue.

PA experienced a sharp and rapid 'Flash Drop' to clear Stop Losses on the Buy side but pulled back immediately, reflecting sustained buying support. The 4,264 zone is the next target; Sell orders must be careful because such fake-outs are usually followed by a Rally.

PA is testing the largest psychological resistance at 4,219, which is the destiny point. If passed, it confirms a perfect Weekly BUY PA and triggers a massive Short Squeeze. But if not passed, this zone will be a sharp reversal point, giving Sell orders one last breath to smash the price down to 4,176.

PA is in a 'Retrace to Continue' phase, with a collection zone at 4,109 - 4,132 acting as a safe reversal point. The aim is to bounce back to 4,230, using this move to eat the Stop Losses of those who rushed to Follow Buy at the previous peak.

The Buy side is 'controlling the birth of a downtrend' (preventing it) by nurturing the price not to drop below 4,176 to maintain the bullish structure and squeezing the price to break the W1 resistance at 4,264. If passed, the massive Sell volume piled there will become fuel to propel the price up strongly.

PA is herding pigs into the pen at the psychological resistance of 4,264 (W1), which is the spot gamblers love to Short the most. The strategy is to hold Buys from the 4,176 base and wait for a violent Breakout to wipe out the entire Sell side board in one go.

PA has entered the 4,200 danger zone, acting as a 'Portfolio Killing Zone.' If the price hits this and leaves a long wick with a sharp drop, it’s a warning that those chasing Buys are about to blow their portfolios. If a Sell PA is confirmed, one must flee for their life immediately before the price dumps.

PA is signaling a warning of a reversal to PA SELL if the candle confirmation succeeds. The strategy now is to stay extremely calm and choose only one Sniper Shot in Zone 2 (Decision Zone) for a short bounce. But if missed, one must surrender immediately because the trend is changing direction.

PA is at a standoff at the 4,200 'Dead Zone.' The current candle must close above this price to maintain the BUY PA structure and force Short Squeezers to surrender. But if it closes lower, it confirms a downtrend immediately, leaving those catching the knife in this zone stuck for a long time.

PA signals readiness to break and continue. The goal is to chase the price on the BUY side up the profit ladder at 4,241 - 4,264. That zone will be where counter-trend Sell orders must accept cutting their final losses before the price hits the major resistance.

The BUY side must emphasize discipline in gradually taking profits at targets 4,241, 4,259, and 4,264. Do not be greedy and hold for the long run in one go, because the W1 resistance at the end is very strong and might slap the price down hard against those who refuse to leave the table.

PA is retracing deeply to test the psychological base at 4,022 - 4,054, which is the final opportunity to 'Reload' BUY ammunition at the start of the cycle to aim for a bounce back to the previous High. This move is used to shake the weak-hearted into spitting out all their goods.

PA has entered 'Wait for News' mode. The best strategy is to clear BUY profits at the 4,200 zone and sit on your hands. During news, prices often whip around to eat Stop Losses on both sides (Kill Zone) before choosing the real direction.

PA standing firmly above 4,210 confirms a continuous BUY PA to challenge the 'Big Boss' at 4,264. That point will be the final war: if passed, it Skyrockets; if not, it becomes an eternal peak for those chasing the price.

The resistance at 4325.87 is not significant. The truly important resistance is at 4346.58. The price has reached it, but there must be a candle closing above 4353.47 to confirm the BUY PA continuation. And if it comes down to hit the key support at 4220.66 and closes below it, the candle that hits and closes below will become the significant resistance. It is not yet known whether that candle will be a reversal resistance point or a dumping point.

The 4346.08 resistance is a resistance that aligns with an old PA SELL resistance, making it a significant level occurring in the same area. When it is not yet time to break, the price can be pushed down hard. The price range is 4257.79 - 4353.47. Therefore, it is not the time to buy at the top hoping for a break (not a rhythm for snowballing). Buying should be done waiting for a buy as close to the lower zone as possible, near 4257.79. Chasing buys at the top is useless, wastes lot size, and damages mental state unnecessarily.

PA is clearly on the BUY side and ready to break the price up. Entry points are provided by analyzing MN and W1 charts to find advantageous placement in H4 and H1. It is forecasted that if the price breaks up to reach the psychological line of 4400, the price will SW around 4410 - 4420. Sell orders located around 4381.38 - 4400 will have a chance to close once. 4381.38 is the TP BUY point from the current chart set and is the worst sell point before reaching 4400. If the price pushes to 4400, that 4381.38 sell order can close itself because that point will be the Sell TP and the first BUY point in the future.
